prompt: Sort each behavior: is it the model, or the harness?

buckets.label: The model
buckets.hint: What the model writes or chooses.

buckets.label: The harness
buckets.hint: The code around the model that runs, limits or checks.

items.text: Chooses the next token from its scores
items.why: The model scores the next tokens and chooses from them. The harness does not choose words.

items.text: Runs the tests after an edit
items.why: The model can ask for a test, but the harness runs it and reads the result.

items.text: Caps a tool output at a set size
items.why: A cap is a harness setting. The model never sees the cut part.

items.text: Writes a sentence that sounds sure
items.why: Tone and fluency come from the model's writing. The sentence does not prove the claim.
The model can say it is done. The harness decides what that means for the run.

items.text: Blocks a shell command that the permissions do not allow
items.why: Permissions are enforced by the harness, not by a line in the prompt.

items.text: Picks which tool to call next
items.why: The model asks for a tool. The harness runs it.

items.text: Adds the earlier messages to each call
items.why: The harness builds the request. The model only reads what it is sent.
